Yolo County Board Game Gathering
Update 8/14/25:
**We're still active**, but we primarily use Discord to chat and plan events. (See group description for invite link.)

We still meet every Wednesday for board games at Blue Note Brewing Company. We'll have a handful of tables reserved near the back; just look for the pile of board games.

People usually start arriving around 5pm, and games start whenever people are ready. Blue Note closes at 9pm, and although we have a 5-10 minute grace period there, you should be in the process of final scoring by 9, or else pack it up and play again another day.

Game night is open to all ages! Blue Note is a brewery, not a bar, so there's no restriction against minors. In addition to their crafted-in-house beer selection, water and sodas are available.

title: Weekly Game Night at Blue Note
description:
Yolo County Board Game Gathering
Update 8/14/25:
**We're still active**, but we primarily use Discord to chat and plan events. (See group description for invite link.)

We still meet every Wednesday for board games at Blue Note Brewing Company. We'll have a handful of tables reserved near the back; just look for the pile of board games.

People usually start arriving around 5pm, and games start whenever people are ready. Blue Note closes at 9pm, and although we have a 5-10 minute grace period there, you should be in the process of final scoring by 9, or else pack it up and play again another day.

Game night is open to all ages! Blue Note is a brewery, not a bar, so there's no restriction against minors. In addition to their crafted-in-house beer selection, water and sodas are available.

You're not required to buy anything in order to join us, but we do encourage you to support local businesses. Blue Note's chef team makes a mean pizza, and there are other nearby downtown restaurants and businesses.

title: Picnic in the Park at Davis Farmers Market – Wednesday Evenings (50th Anniversary Year)
location: Central Park, 301 C St., Davis, CA, 95616, United States
description:
The beloved Picnic in the Park season is back at the Davis Farmers Market starting Wednesday, April 1, 2026!

Shop fresh produce, artisan goods, and a wide variety of prepared foods from your favorite vendors. Enjoy local craft beer, wine, and brand new this year – mead!

This year is extra special as the Davis Farmers Market celebrates its 50th Anniversary! Don’t miss the big anniversary celebration on Saturday, August 1, 2026. 
New in 2026: The Market Memories Cookbook (presale now at davis-farmers-market). 
Highlights Include: 

Buckhorn Food Truck, The Hotdogger, Dhillon Farm, Davis Bread & Desserts, Greek Table, Kettle Pop & more
Live music every week
Kids’ activities
Local beer, wine & mead

Free to attend – everyone is welcome!

title: Sculptural Papermaking with Bev Barnett
description:
Pence Adult Art Programs
With artist Bev Barnett, embark on a unique adventure to transform ordinary household recycling, kitchen waste, and foraged botanicals into textured handmade paper that tells a compelling story. In this workshop, we’ll move beyond the notion that paper should be flat, creating low-relief sculpture and highly textured sheets. You’ll master a simple, low-water method using a household blender to macerate pulp and learn how to incorporate color without messy dyes. By the time you leave, you’ll have 8 to 10 handmade papers, a blueprint for your own home studio, and the confidence to keep creating.

Sculptural Papermaking with Bev Barnett
Saturday\, August 22 \| 10 AM \- 2 PM
$115 Members, $125 Non-Members (All materials included)

**Registration is required through the [Pence's website (CLICK HERE)](https://pencegallery.org/education/programs/workshops-and-classes/).**

Any questions? Email pencegallery@gmail.com.

title: Davis City Council Meetings
location: City Hall Community Chambers, 23 Russell Blvd, Davis, CA, 95616, United States
description:
The Davis City Council provides policy direction, establishes goals, and sets priorities for City government. City Council holds regular meetings beginning at 6:30 p.m. on Tuesdays. Most commonly, meetings are held on the first and third Tuesdays of the month, with additional meetings scheduled as needed. The City Council meeting schedule is subject to change. 
  
The Davis City Council meets in the Community Chambers at City Hall, 23 Russell Boulevard. All regular meeting materials are posted at least 72 hours in advance and special meeting materials at least 24 hours in advance. 
  
Visit the City Council site for information on agenda, special meetings, and more.

title: Human Relations Commission Meetings
location: City Hall Community Chambers, 23 Russell Blvd, Davis, CA, 95616, United States
description:
The Davis Human Relations Commission (HRC) meetings aim to promote mutual respect, understanding, justice, and advancing the human rights of all people. The Human Relations Commission meets on the fourth Thursday of each month at 6:30 p.m. The Commission takes a recess in July (no meeting in July). 
  
Meetings take place in the Community Chambers at City Hall, 23 Russell Boulevard. For more information on meetings, membership, resolutions, and more, visit the Human Relations Commission site. 
  
The HRC makes recommendations around equity and discrimination in the City, and supports the City in preventing and addressing discrimination while promoting diversity, equality, and justice relevant to the goals and policies of the City Council. 
  
To contact or send emails to the commission, email: HRC@cityofdavis.org

title: Weekly Game Night at Blue Note
description:
Yolo County Board Game Gathering
Update 8/14/25:
**We're still active**, but we primarily use Discord to chat and plan events. (See group description for invite link.)

We still meet every Wednesday for board games at Blue Note Brewing Company. We'll have a handful of tables reserved near the back; just look for the pile of board games.

People usually start arriving around 5pm, and games start whenever people are ready. Blue Note closes at 9pm, and although we have a 5-10 minute grace period there, you should be in the process of final scoring by 9, or else pack it up and play again another day.

Game night is open to all ages! Blue Note is a brewery, not a bar, so there's no restriction against minors. In addition to their crafted-in-house beer selection, water and sodas are available.

You're not required to buy anything in order to join us, but we do encourage you to support local businesses. Blue Note's chef team makes a mean pizza, and there are other nearby downtown restaurants and businesses.

title: Human Relations Commission Meetings
location: City Hall Community Chambers, 23 Russell Blvd, Davis, CA, 95616, United States
description:
The Davis Human Relations Commission (HRC) meetings aim to promote mutual respect, understanding, justice, and advancing the human rights of all people. The Human Relations Commission meets on the fourth Thursday of each month at 6:30 p.m. The Commission takes a recess in July (no meeting in July). 
  
Meetings take place in the Community Chambers at City Hall, 23 Russell Boulevard. For more information on meetings, membership, resolutions, and more, visit the Human Relations Commission site. 
  
The HRC makes recommendations around equity and discrimination in the City, and supports the City in preventing and addressing discrimination while promoting diversity, equality, and justice relevant to the goals and policies of the City Council. 
  
To contact or send emails to the commission, email: HRC@cityofdavis.org
